## Research status

**Technical owners.** 6 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Artifact Steward Agents and Living Project Governance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/artifact-steward-agents-and-living-project-governance.html), [Integrated Reference Architecture](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/integrated-reference-architecture.html), [Project Theseus as Report-First Implementation Reference](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/project-theseus-as-report-first-implementation-reference.html), [Prototype Roadmap](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/prototype-roadmap.html), [Living Book Methodology](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/living-book-methodology.html), [Open Research Agenda and Bibliography Plan](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/open-research-agenda-and-bibliography-plan.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 22.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Fresh-checkout natural tasks, independent reproduction, governance-rent ablations, and end-to-end failure tests that favor a simpler system would narrow or reject the reference design.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
